method: Six command binaries without the eBPF-heavy core/security/system-probe targets, after six- and five-binary manifest-size rejections. Vanilla toplevel warmup, SkyCache minimal/toplevel preparation, then three rotated repetitions of vanilla/off/on per policy. Shutdown and synchronous clean before every build; verify zero graph and deleted outputs/action cache. Same output base, 6 GiB JVM, 16 jobs, 6144 MiB action budget, bounded remote transport 1 connection x 16 requests. Cache & Carry remote cache and BES enabled. Warm OS and external repository caches. Build time excludes clean; combined time also recorded. Process-tree PSS/RSS sampled every 100 ms.
